look_here_first: Evergreen limestone shrub or small tree with glossy pinnate leaves, dense hanging clusters of purple pea-flowers, and thick woody pods containing bright red seeds.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Fabaceae: alternate compound leaves, papilionoid pea-flowers, and legume pods.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: dense pendulous clusters of violet-purple papilionoid flowers

lookalikes.differences: Compared with Lupinus texensis and Senna roemeriana, Texas mountain laurel is woody and evergreen. Its glossy pinnate leaves, hanging purple flower clusters, and woody seed pods make it unmistakable among local Fabaceae once mature.
